_comment: Machine-readable task manifest, mirroring state/fix_plan.md. JSON on purpose: the model is less likely to inappropriately rewrite a JSON manifest than Markdown, which makes 'status'/'passes' a sturdier done-guardrail. /plan populates this; /work advances 'status' through the workflow. The loop/work may edit ONLY 'status', 'passes', and 'evidence' — never 'description'/'acceptance'. Enumerate granularly so victory can't be declared prematurely. 'files' = the paths/dirs this task OWNS (its write-scope); the fleet runner (harness/fleet.*) only parallelizes tasks whose ownership doesn't overlap — omit/empty means never parallelized.

tasks.description: Preserve the available Codex transcript when the phase watchdog kills a timed-out invocation.
steps: Reproduce the PowerShell timeout path with output emitted before the watchdog fires
Keep the timeout fail-closed while retaining the available output plus the timeout verdict in the phase log
Add mutation-checked regression coverage and reconcile the Bash twin's contract
Bump plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json in the same diff as the shipped Invoke-Codex behavior change
tasks.acceptance: A timed-out Codex invocation still returns failure and is rolled back, while its phase log durably contains output produced before the timeout and the watchdog verdict.
